newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan's DG Khan Cement 3.35 pct up.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan's DG Khan Cement 3.35 pct up.

text.p: Pakistan's D.G. Khan Cement's 10-rupee stock rose 0.45, or 3.35 percent, to 13.90 on Saturday after measures to benefit the cement sector were announced in Friday's 1997/98 (July-June) budget, dealers said.
Some 183,000 shares changed hands in a special post-budget computerised trading session, dealer Mohammad Ali said. He said the budget changes would boost the profits of cement firms.
The budget scrapped a 12.5 percent sales tax on cement, but increased excise duty on cement to 40 percent from 35 percent.
"Because of high tax rates, the cement production capacity is not being utilised properly," Finance Minister Sartaj Aziz said in his budget speech to parliament.
